name: DATABASE_URL
description: Postgres connection string (pooled in hosted).

name: UPTEMPO_MODE
description: Deployment mode: multi (default, hosted platform) or single (one business).

name: APP_URL
description: Runtime public base URL, read by getBaseUrl().

name: PORT
description: Dev server port. Auth trusted origins include localhost and 127.0.0.1 on this port. Defaults to 3000.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
description: Public base URL inlined at build time.

name: ROOT_DOMAIN
description: Root domain for tenant subdomains (default bookuptempo.com).

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_ROOT_DOMAIN
description: Client-visible root domain for the admin sidebar.

name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
description: Better Auth signing secret (read implicitly by better-auth).

name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
description: Better Auth base URL (read implicitly by better-auth).

name: BOOKING_SESSION_SECRET
description: HMAC secret for booking session cookies, email tokens and signed private file URLs.

name: FILE_LINK_SECRET
description: HMAC secret for tenant attachment links (/api/attachments). Falls back to BOOKING_SESSION_SECRET.

name: PAYMENTS_FAKE
description: Test only: set to 1 to make off-session charges succeed without Stripe. Ignored in production.

name: CRON_SECRET
description: Bearer secret protecting /api/cron/* routes.

name: UPTEMPO_SOURCE_URL
description: Public source-code URL shown by the /source route (AGPL).

name: UPTEMPO_VERSION
description: Version string reported by /api/health.

name: AUTH_EXTRA_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
description: Comma-separated extra origins trusted by Better Auth.

name: PREVIEW_TENANT_SLUG
description: Tenant slug used for preview deployments.

name: SKIP_BOOTSTRAP_CHECK
description: Set to 1 to skip the local bootstrap check (dev and CI).

name: DATABASE_SHARD_URLS
description: Comma-separated shard connection strings.

name: NEW_TENANT_SHARD
description: Shard id for newly provisioned tenants.

name: UPTEMPO_WORKER_TARGET_URL
description: Base URL the worker container calls for cron routes.

name: VERCEL
description: Set by Vercel; gates Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights. Never set by hand.

name: VERCEL_ENV
description: Set by Vercel (production, preview, development). Never set by hand.

name: VERCEL_URL
description: Set by Vercel: deployment hostname. Never set by hand.

name: VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL
description: Set by Vercel: production hostname. Never set by hand.

name: STORAGE_PROVIDER
description: File storage backend: vercel-blob, local or s3.

name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
description: Vercel Blob read-write token (selects vercel-blob when set).

name: STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR
description: Directory for the local storage provider (default /data/uploads in production, .uploads in dev).

name: S3_ENDPOINT
description: S3-compatible endpoint URL (required when STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3).

name: S3_REGION
description: S3 region (default auto).

name: S3_BUCKET
description: S3 bucket name (required when STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3).

name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
description: S3 access key id (required when STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3).

name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
description: S3 secret access key (required when STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3).

name: S3_PUBLIC_URL
description: Public base URL for objects (required when STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3).

name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
description: Use path-style S3 URLs (default true; MinIO and R2).

name: EMAIL_PROVIDER
description: Email backend: resend, smtp or console.

name: RESEND_API_KEY
description: Resend API key (required when EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend).

name: EMAIL_FROM
description: Default From address.

name: SMTP_HOST
description: SMTP host (required when EMAIL_PROVIDER=smtp).

name: SMTP_PORT
description: SMTP port (default 587).

name: SMTP_USER
description: SMTP username.

name: SMTP_PASSWORD
description: SMTP password.

name: SMTP_SECURE
description: true for implicit TLS (port 465).

name: QUIZ_NOTIFY_EMAIL
description: Recipient for quiz lead notifications.

name: WAITLIST_NOTIFY_EMAIL
description: Recipient for waitlist signup notifications.

name: SMS_PROVIDER
description: SMS backend: twilio, loopmessage or none.

name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
description: Twilio account SID (required when SMS_PROVIDER=twilio).

name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
description: Twilio auth token.

name: TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID
description: Twilio messaging service SID.

name: LOOPMESSAGE_AUTH_KEY
description: LoopMessage authorization key.

name: LOOPMESSAGE_SECRET_KEY
description: LoopMessage secret key.

name: LOOPMESSAGE_SENDER
description: LoopMessage sender name.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_LOOPMESSAGE_OPTIN_URL
description: LoopMessage iMessage opt-in link shown to clients.

name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
description: Stripe secret key (payments are off without it in single mode).

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
description: Stripe publishable key (build arg).

name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
description: Stripe webhook signing secret (required when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set).

name: PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT
description: Platform fee percentage (forced to 0 in single mode).

name: DOMAINS_PROVIDER
description: Custom-domain backend: vercel or none.

name: DOMAIN_MAP_PROVIDER
description: Domain-to-tenant map: global-config, static or none.

name: VERCEL_TOKEN
description: Vercel API token for custom domains.

name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
description: Vercel project id for custom domains.

name: VERCEL_TEAM_ID
description: Vercel team id for custom domains.

name: GLOBAL_CONFIG
description: Vercel Global Config connection string (replaces EDGE_CONFIG).

name: GLOBAL_CONFIG_ID
description: Vercel Global Config id (replaces EDGE_CONFIG_ID).

name: EDGE_CONFIG
description: Legacy name for GLOBAL_CONFIG. The Global Config SDK still reads it.

name: EDGE_CONFIG_ID
description: Legacy name for GLOBAL_CONFIG_ID.

name: UPTEMPO_DOMAIN_MAP
description: Static domain map: host=slug,host=slug (DOMAIN_MAP_PROVIDER=static).

name: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID
description: Google OAuth client id for calendar sync.

name: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET
description: Google OAuth client secret for calendar sync.

name: APNS_KEY_ID
description: Apple push key id.

name: APNS_TEAM_ID
description: Apple developer team id.

name: APNS_PRIVATE_KEY
description: Apple push private key (.p8 contents).

name: APNS_BUNDLE_ID_OWNER
description: Owner app bundle id for push.

name: APNS_BUNDLE_ID_CLIENT
description: Client app bundle id for push.

name: APPLE_APP_ID_CLIENT
description: Client app id for universal links.

name: APPLE_APP_ID_OWNER
description: Owner app id for universal links.

name: NATIVE_OWNER_URL_SCHEME
description: Owner native app URL scheme.

name: NATIVE_CLIENT_URL_SCHEME
description: Client native app URL scheme.

name: REVIEW_OTP_EMAIL
description: App Store review login email (fixed OTP).

name: REVIEW_OTP_CODE
description: App Store review fixed OTP code.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID
description: Google Analytics measurement id; GA is off when unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN
description: PostHog project token; PostHog is off when unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST
description: PostHog host.

name: BUILD_STANDALONE
description: Set to 1 to build Next.js in standalone output mode.

name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
description: Docker Compose profiles to enable.

name: POSTGRES_USER
description: Postgres user for the bundled compose database.

name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
description: Postgres password for the bundled compose database.

name: POSTGRES_DB
description: Postgres database name for the bundled compose database.

name: UPTEMPO_PORT
description: Host port published by compose.

name: ENV_FILE
description: Env file path for scripts/migrate-*-calendar.ts (default .env.local).

name: USE_TEMPLATE_EMAIL_ENV
description: Env file override for scripts/send-test-template-emails.ts.
